user.title: Tides Plus (USA, NOAA)
user.description: Enter a location to find nearby tide stations — a US ZIP code, a place name like "Bridgeport, CT", or a 7-digit NOAA station ID to skip the picker. Leave blank to use your Home Assistant home location.

error.unknown_station: That station ID was not found at NOAA.
error.not_tidal: That station exists but does not publish tide predictions.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the NOAA API. Try again in a moment.
error.geocode_failed: Could not find a place matching that search. Try a ZIP code or "City, ST".
error.no_home_location: Home Assistant has no home coordinates set. Enter a location or set your home in Settings → System → General.
